statement:
lemma Matrix.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_zero_external_row [DivisionRing F] [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (A : Matrix X Y F)
    (x : X) (y : Y) {X' Y' : Type*} (f : X' → X) (g : Y' → Y) (hf : x ∉ f.range) (hg : y ∉ g.range) (hAg : ∀ j, A x (g j) = 0) :
    (A.shortTableauPivot x y).submatrix f g = A.submatrix f g
proof:
:= by
  unfold Matrix.shortTableauPivot Matrix.longTableauPivot
  aesop

name: Matrix.submatrix_shortTableauPivot
statement:
lemma Matrix.submatrix_shortTableauPivot [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] {X' Y' : Type*} [DecidableEq X'] [DecidableEq Y']
    [DivisionRing F] {f : X' → X} {g : Y' → Y}
    (A : Matrix X Y F) (hf : f.Injective) (hg : g.Injective) (x : X') (y : Y') :
    (A.submatrix f g).shortTableauPivot x y = (A.shortTableauPivot (f x) (g y)).submatrix f g
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hfix : f i = f x → i = x := (hf ·)
  have hgjy : g j = g y → j = y := (hg ·)
  unfold Matrix.shortTableauPivot Matrix.longTableauPivot
  aesop

name: Matrix.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_succAbove_pivot_apply
statement:
private lemma Matrix.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_succAbove_pivot_apply [Field F] {k : ℕ} {x y : Fin k.succ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin k.succ) (Fin k.succ) F) (i j : Fin k) :
    (A.shortTableauPivot x y).submatrix x.succAbove y.succAbove i j =
    A (x.succAbove i) (y.succAbove j) - A (x.succAbove i) y * A x (y.succAbove j) / A x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.shortTableauPivot, Matrix.longTableauPivot, y.succAbove_ne j, x.succAbove_ne i, div_mul_eq_mul_div]

name: Matrix.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_eq
statement:
private lemma Matrix.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_eq [Field F] {k : ℕ} {x y : Fin k.succ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin k.succ) (Fin k.succ) F) :
    (A.shortTableauPivot x y).submatrix x.succAbove y.succAbove =
    Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin k => A (x.succAbove i) (y.succAbove j) - A (x.succAbove i) y * A x (y.succAbove j) / A x y)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact A.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_succAbove_pivot_apply i j

name: Fin.reindexFun_bijective
statement: private lemma Fin.reindexFun_bijective {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n.succ) : i.reindexFun.Bijective
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n => fun hab : i.reindexFun a = i.reindexFun b => by
    cases a with
    | inl a₁ =>
      cases b with
      | inl b₁ =>
        congr
        apply fin1_eq_fin1
      | inr bₙ =>
        exfalso
        apply i.succAbove_ne bₙ
        simpa using hab.symm
    | inr aₙ =>
      cases b with
      | inl b₁ =>
        exfalso
        apply i.succAbove_ne aₙ
        simpa using hab
      | inr bₙ =>
        simpa using hab,
    (by
      if hi : i = · then
        use ◩0
      else
        aesop)⟩

name: reindexing_symm_eq_left
statement:
private lemma reindexing_symm_eq_left {n : ℕ} (i k : Fin n.succ) (j : Fin 1) :
    i.reindexing.symm k = ◩j ↔ i = k
proof:
:= by
  unfold Fin.reindexing
  constructor <;> intro hk
  on_goal 1 =>
    apply_fun i.reindexFun at hk
    rw [Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply i.reindexFun i.reindexFun_bijective k] at hk
  on_goal 2 =>
    apply_fun i.reindexFun using i.reindexFun_bijective.left
    rw [Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply i.reindexFun i.reindexFun_bijective k]
  all_goals
    simp [hk]

name: reindexing_symm_eq_right
statement:
private lemma reindexing_symm_eq_right {n : ℕ} (i k : Fin n.succ) (j : Fin n) :
    i.reindexing.symm k = ◪j ↔ k = (i.succAbove j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Fin.reindexing
  constructor <;> intro hkj
  on_goal 1 =>
    apply_fun i.reindexFun at hkj
    rw [Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply i.reindexFun i.reindexFun_bijective k] at hkj
  on_goal 2 =>
    apply_fun i.reindexFun using i.reindexFun_bijective.1
    rw [Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply i.reindexFun i.reindexFun_bijective k]
  all_goals
    simp [hkj]

name: Matrix.succAboveAt_block
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  cases hx : x.reindexing.symm i <;> cases hy : y.reindexing.symm j
  on_goal 1 => rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]
  on_goal 2 => rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂]
  on_goal 3 => rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁]
  on_goal 4 => rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂]
  all_goals
    try rw [reindexing_symm_eq_left] at hx
    try rw [reindexing_symm_eq_left] at hy
    try rw [reindexing_symm_eq_right] at hx
    try rw [reindexing_symm_eq_right] at hy
    subst hx hy
    simp

name: Matrix.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_eq_blockish
statement:
private lemma Matrix.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_eq_blockish [Field F] {k : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin k.succ) (Fin k.succ) F) (x y : Fin k.succ) :
    (A.shortTableauPivot x y).submatrix x.succAbove y.succAbove =
    (A.block₂₂ x y) - (A.block₂₁ x y) * (A.block₁₁ x y)⁻¹ * (A.block₁₂ x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_eq]
  conv in _ / _ => rw [div_eq_mul_inv _ (A x y)]
  rw [show (A.block₁₁ x y)⁻¹ = !![(A x y)⁻¹] from Matrix.ext (by simp [·.eq_zero, ·.eq_zero])]
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, mul_right_comm]

name: shortTableauPivot_submatrix_succAbove_succAbove_det_abs_eq_div
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero (A.block₁₁ x y 0 0) := ⟨by simpa⟩
  rw [
    Matrix.shortTableauPivot_submatrix_eq_blockish, eq_div_iff_mul_eq (abs_ne_zero.← hAxy), mul_comm,
    ←show (A.block₁₁ x y).det = A x y from Matrix.det_fin_one_of _,
    ←abs_mul, ←(A.block₁₁ x y).invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, ←Matrix.det_fromBlocks₁₁]
  nth_rw 5 [A.succAboveAt_block x y]
  exact (Matrix.abs_det_submatrix_equiv_equiv ..).symm

name: shortTableauPivot_submatrix_det_abs_eq_div
statement:
lemma shortTableauPivot_submatrix_det_abs_eq_div [LinearOrderedField F] {k : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin k.succ) (Fin k.succ) F} {x y : Fin k.succ} (hAxy : A x y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ f : Fin k → Fin k.succ, ∃ g : Fin k → Fin k.succ,
      |((A.shortTableauPivot x y).submatrix f g).det| = |A.det| / |A x y|
proof:
:=
  ⟨x.succAbove, y.succAbove, shortTableauPivot_submatrix_succAbove_succAbove_det_abs_eq_div hAxy⟩

name: Matrix.abs_det_eq_shortTableauPivot_submatrix_abs_det
statement:
lemma Matrix.abs_det_eq_shortTableauPivot_submatrix_abs_det [LinearOrderedField F] {k : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin k.succ) (Fin k.succ) F) {i j : Fin k.succ} (hAij : A i j = 1 ∨ A i j = -1) :
    ∃ f : Fin k → Fin k.succ, ∃ g : Fin k → Fin k.succ,
      |A.det| = |((A.shortTableauPivot i j).submatrix f g).det|
proof:
:= by
  have hAij0 : A i j ≠ 0
  · cases hAij with
    | inl h1 => exact ne_zero_of_eq_one h1
    | inr h9 => simp [h9]
  obtain ⟨f, g, hAfg⟩ := shortTableauPivot_submatrix_det_abs_eq_div hAij0
  have hAij1 : |A i j| = 1
  · cases hAij with
    | inl h1 => rw [h1, abs_one]
    | inr h9 => rw [h9, abs_neg, abs_one]
  rw [hAij1, div_one] at hAfg
  exact ⟨f, g, hAfg.symm⟩

name: Basis.linearIndepOn_in_submodule_aux
proof:
:=
  let c : (G →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (G → R) := ⟨⟨Finsupp.toFun, ↓↓rfl⟩, ↓↓rfl⟩
  ⟨fun hI => (linearIndependent_iff.← ↓(hI ·)).of_comp c,
    (c.linearIndependent_iff (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.← DFunLike.coe_injective')).←⟩

name: Basis.linearIndepOn_in_submodule
statement:
lemma Basis.linearIndepOn_in_submodule (B : Basis G R (Submodule.span R A.range)) (hAI : LinearIndepOn R A hIX.elem.range) :
    LinearIndepOn R (fun x : X => fun g : G => B.repr ⟨A x, in_submoduleSpan_range A x⟩ g) hIX.elem.range
proof:
:= by
  rw [B.linearIndepOn_in_submodule_aux]
  rw [LinearMap.linearIndepOn_iff_of_injOn]
  · exact hAI.of_comp (Submodule.span R A.range).subtype
  · exact LinearMap.injOn_of_disjoint_ker (Submodule.span_mono (hIX.elem.range.image_subset_range _)) (by simp)

name: Basis.linearIndepOn_of_in_submodule
statement:
lemma Basis.linearIndepOn_of_in_submodule (B : Basis G R (Submodule.span R A.range))
    (hBI : LinearIndepOn R (fun x : X => fun g : G => B.repr ⟨A x, in_submoduleSpan_range A x⟩ g) hIX.elem.range) :
    LinearIndepOn R A hIX.elem.range
proof:
:= by
  rw [B.linearIndepOn_in_submodule_aux, LinearMap.linearIndepOn_iff_of_injOn] at hBI
  · rw [linearIndepOn_iff'] at hBI ⊢
    intro s c hs hsc
    apply hBI s c hs
    ext j
    simpa using congr_fun hsc j
  · exact LinearMap.injOn_of_disjoint_ker (Submodule.span_mono (hIX.elem.range.image_subset_range _)) (by simp)

name: Matrix.one_fromCols_transpose
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Matrix.one_fromCols_transpose [Zero α] [One α] {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) :
    (1 ◫ A)ᵀ = (1 : Matrix m m α) ⊟ Aᵀ
proof:
:= by
  rw [←Matrix.transpose_one, ←Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.transpose_one]

name: Matrix.one_fromRows_transpose
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Matrix.one_fromRows_transpose [Zero α] [One α] {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n α) :
    (1 ⊟ A)ᵀ = ((1 : Matrix n n α) ◫ Aᵀ : Matrix ..)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←Matrix.transpose_one, ←Matrix.transpose_fromRows, Matrix.transpose_one]

name: Matrix.fromCols_one_transpose
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Matrix.fromCols_one_transpose [Zero α] [One α] {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n α) :
    (A ◫ 1)ᵀ = Aᵀ ⊟ (1 : Matrix m m α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←Matrix.transpose_one, ←Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.transpose_one]

name: Matrix.fromRows_one_transpose
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Matrix.fromRows_one_transpose [Zero α] [One α] {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix m n α) :
    (A ⊟ 1)ᵀ = (Aᵀ ◫ (1 : Matrix n n α) : Matrix ..)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←Matrix.transpose_one, ←Matrix.transpose_fromRows, Matrix.transpose_one]

name: Matrix.ext_col
statement: lemma Matrix.ext_col {m n : Type*} {A B : Matrix m n α} (hAB : ∀ i : m, A i = B i) : A = B
proof:
:=
  Matrix.ext (congr_fun <| hAB ·)

name: Matrix.det_int_coe
statement:
lemma Matrix.det_int_coe [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] (A : Matrix α α ℤ) (F : Type*) [Field F] :
    ((A.det : ℤ) : F) = ((A.map Int.cast).det : F)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.det_apply, Int.cast_sum, Matrix.map_apply]
  congr
  ext p
  if h1 : p.sign = 1 then
    simp [h1]
  else
    simp [Int.units_ne_iff_eq_neg.→ h1]

name: Matrix.entrywiseProduct_outerProduct_eq_mul_col_mul_row
statement:
lemma Matrix.entrywiseProduct_outerProduct_eq_mul_col_mul_row {m n : Type*} [Semigroup α]
    (A : Matrix m n α) (c : m → α) (r : n → α) :
    A ⊡ c ⊗ r = Matrix.of (fun i : m => fun j : n => (A i j * c i) * r j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: Matrix.entrywiseProduct_outerProduct_eq_mul_row_mul_col
statement:
lemma Matrix.entrywiseProduct_outerProduct_eq_mul_row_mul_col {m n : Type*} [CommSemigroup α]
    (A : Matrix m n α) (c : m → α) (r : n → α) :
    A ⊡ c ⊗ r = Matrix.of (fun i : m => fun j : n => (A i j * r j) * c i)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  nth_rw 2 [mul_comm]
  rw [mul_assoc]

name: sum_elem_smul_matrix_row_of_mem
statement:
lemma sum_elem_smul_matrix_row_of_mem [DecidableEq α] {β : Type*} [NonAssocSemiring β] {x : α} {S : Set α} [Fintype S]
    (f : α → β) (hxS : x ∈ S) :
    ∑ i : S.Elem, f i • (1 : Matrix α α β) x i.val = f x
proof:
:= by
  convert sum_elem_of_single_nonzero hxS (fun a : α => fun ha : a ≠ x =>
    show f a • (1 : Matrix α α β) x a = 0 by simp [Matrix.one_apply_ne' ha])
  rw [Matrix.one_apply_eq x, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: sum_elem_smul_matrix_row_of_nmem
statement:
lemma sum_elem_smul_matrix_row_of_nmem [DecidableEq α] {β : Type*} [NonAssocSemiring β] {x : α} {S : Set α} [Fintype S]
    (f : α → β) (hxS : x ∉ S) :
    ∑ i : S.Elem, f i • (1 : Matrix α α β) x i.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro y _
  rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne' (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem y.property hxS)]
  apply smul_zero

name: sum_one_times_matrix
statement:
lemma sum_one_times_matrix {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [CommSemiring β] {x : α} [Fintype α]
    (f : α → β) :
    ∑ i : α, (1 : Matrix α α β) x i * f i = f x
proof:
:= by
  convert fintype_sum_of_single_nonzero (fun i : α => (1 : Matrix α α β) x i * f i) x (by
    intro i hix
    convert zero_mul _
    exact Matrix.one_apply_ne' hix
  )
  simp

name: sum_matrix_times_one
statement:
lemma sum_matrix_times_one {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [CommSemiring β] {x : α} [Fintype α]
    (f : α → β) :
    ∑ i : α, f i * (1 : Matrix α α β) x i = f x
proof:
:= by
  convert fintype_sum_of_single_nonzero (fun i : α => f i * (1 : Matrix α α β) x i) x (by
    intro i hix
    convert mul_zero _
    exact Matrix.one_apply_ne' hix
  )
  simp

name: Matrix.isTotallyUnimodular_iff_forall_isPartiallyUnimodular
statement:
lemma Matrix.isTotallyUnimodular_iff_forall_isPartiallyUnimodular (A : Matrix X Y R) :
    A.IsTotallyUnimodular ↔ ∀ k : ℕ, A.IsPartiallyUnimodular k
proof:
:=
  A.isTotallyUnimodular_iff

name: Matrix.toMatrixUnionUnion_transpose
statement:
lemma Matrix.toMatrixUnionUnion_transpose (A : Matrix (T₁.Elem ⊕ T₂.Elem) (S₁.Elem ⊕ S₂.Elem) R) :
    A.toMatrixUnionUnion.transpose = A.transpose.toMatrixUnionUnion
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Matrix.IsTotallyUnimodular.toMatrixUnionUnion
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isTotallyUnimodular_iff] at hA ⊢
  intros
  apply hA

name: Matrix.IsSigningOf.toMatrixUnionUnion
statement:
lemma Matrix.IsSigningOf.toMatrixUnionUnion [LinearOrderedRing R]
    {A : Matrix (T₁ ⊕ T₂) (S₁ ⊕ S₂) R} {U : Matrix (T₁ ⊕ T₂) (S₁ ⊕ S₂) Z2}
    (hAU : A.IsSigningOf U) :
    A.toMatrixUnionUnion.IsSigningOf U.toMatrixUnionUnion
proof:
:=
  (hAU ·.toSum ·.toSum)

name: Matrix.toMatrixElemElem_apply
statement:
lemma Matrix.toMatrixElemElem_apply (A : Matrix (T₁ ⊕ T₂) (S₁ ⊕ S₂) R) (hT : T = T₁ ∪ T₂) (hS : S = S₁ ∪ S₂) (i : T) (j : S) :
    A.toMatrixElemElem hT hS i j = A (hT ▸ i).toSum (hS ▸ j).toSum
proof:
:= by
  subst hT hS
  rfl

name: Matrix.IsTotallyUnimodular.toMatrixElemElem
proof:
:=
  hT ▸ hS ▸ hA.toMatrixUnionUnion

name: Matrix.IsSigningOf.toMatrixElemElem
statement:
lemma Matrix.IsSigningOf.toMatrixElemElem [LinearOrderedRing R]
    {A : Matrix (T₁ ⊕ T₂) (S₁ ⊕ S₂) R} {U : Matrix (T₁ ⊕ T₂) (S₁ ⊕ S₂) Z2}
    (hAU : A.IsSigningOf U) (hT : T = T₁ ∪ T₂) (hS : S = S₁ ∪ S₂) :
    (A.toMatrixElemElem hT hS).IsSigningOf (U.toMatrixElemElem hT hS)
proof:
:=
  hT ▸ hS ▸ hAU.toMatrixUnionUnion
